article.title: Why the first 100 days define everything
article.quote: Sense of belonging isn't a luxury. It's a prerequisite for learning.
article.alinea1: Students who fail to integrate within the first 100 days have a significantly higher chance of dropping out before their second year.
article.alinea2: Higher education requires academic integration (attendance, active participation, deadlines) and social integration (finding friends, building confidence in an unfamiliar environment).
article.alinea3: Through game mechanics — levels, collectibles, peer recognition — Quest100 transforms pro-social behavior into intrinsically motivating activities for ~14,000 KdG students across 77 programs.
